subject: URG: SummitBank production degradation after quant profile update
messages:
From: Molly Chen <molly.chen@summitbank.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@summitbank.com
Date: 2028-03-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Spike in 5xx and latency after your March 3rd quant profile push

Hi Mateo,

We started seeing a sharp increase in 5xx errors and P95 latency on our payments inference endpoint starting ~02:00 UTC last night (Mar 4). Error rate rose from 0.2% to ~3.8% and P95 jumped from 210ms to ~1.4s. The spike aligns with the "q-v2.3-a" quant profile you rolled into our serving group.

This is causing transaction timeouts for live customers. Can you advise immediately? We are pausing outgoing payments until this is resolved.

Thanks,
Molly Chen
Head of Platform Reliability, SummitBank

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Molly Chen <molly.chen@summitbank.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-04T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx and latency after your March 3rd quant profile push

Hi Molly — thank you for the heads up and I'm sorry for the impact. We saw the rollout complete to your production pool at 00:45 UTC on Mar 4.

Immediate plan:
- I've flagged infra and initiated an emergency rollback to the previous profile (q-v2.2-stable) for the affected model instances.
- Marcus is onboarding the tracing bundle — can you share any additional logs (sampling from 02:00-03:30 UTC) if you have them?
- We'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until service is back to baseline.

Attaching a short playbook we use for rollbacks.

Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Molly Chen <molly.chen@summitbank.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-04T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx and latency after your March 3rd quant profile push

On it — I've pulled the perf sampling traces and a hot-spot appears in the decoder kernel when sequences hit ~512 tokens. The q-v2.3-a profile shifts int8 packing which improves throughput for short sequences but seems to thrash the KV cache for SummitBank's long-context requests.

Rolling back now (begin rollback 09:33 PDT). I will post timestamps when instances finish.

--Marcus Lin
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Molly Chen <molly.chen@summitbank.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx and latency after your March 3rd quant profile push

Molly — quick update: rollback completed for 70% of instances at 09:58 PDT, we're observing error rate falling and P95 trending down toward baseline. Marcus will keep the last 30% under watch and apply a staged rollback if needed.

We will also kick off a narrow regression test suite against a SummitBank prompt set before proposing a re-deploy.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: CFO SummitBank <cfo@summitbank.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Molly Chen <molly.chen@summitbank.com>, procurement@summitbank.com
Date: 2028-03-04T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx and latency after your March 3rd quant profile push

This is now an executive issue. We've paused two merchant flows and my team is escalating to chargebacks if not restored by EOD. Lauren — I need a clear timeline and a mitigation plan, and we expect a postmortem with root cause and guardrails.

Please escalate internally and keep me copied.

- A. Patel
CFO, SummitBank

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: CFO SummitBank <cfo@summitbank.com>, Molly Chen <molly.chen@summitbank.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-05T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx and latency after your March 3rd quant profile push

A. Patel / Molly — short executive summary and next steps: 

1) What happened: An aggressive int8 packing change in q-v2.3-a improved token throughput for short requests but increased KV cache displacement for long-context workloads. For SummitBank's median sequence length (~420 tokens) this produced additional decoder re-computation and transient failures under peak load.

2) Immediate remediation (completed): Full rollback to q-v2.2-stable completed at 10:38 PDT on Mar 4; error rates returned to baseline (~0.25%) and P95 reduced to ~230ms by 11:10 PDT. We maintained a conservative serving concurrency cap while monitoring.

3) Next 72-hour actions:
- Root cause RCA (INF-7312) with kernel-level traces and prompt set reproduce (owner: Marcus). Target initial RCA draft in 24 hours.
- Guardrail changes: add canary criteria for sequence-length distribution and an automated KV-cache pressure check to block future qprofile rollouts (owner: Mateo/Infra).
- Offer: Two weeks of committed high-priority support and a credit for the outage window (we will coordinate with your procurement team).

4) Asking SummitBank: share a 1-hour sample trace around peak hour and any business-critical prompt templates so our repro harness covers your top workloads. Attachments: perf_logs_20280304.zip (traces), service_trace_0310.txt, rollback_playbook.md

We apologize for the disruption. I'll be available for a call now if you want to walk the timeline.

Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
